translations.en: "Do you have a death wish?"
A diary lay on the ground.
"Why only that girl?"
"I just wanted to play with everyone."
Suddenly, you heard a piercing scream.
"Don't leave me alone!!!"
A drop of water fell on the back of your neck!
You obtained the @3rEvil Boots@0r.
You obtained @3rKotetsu@0r.
You obtained ten @3rTeleport Scrolls@0r.
There was a statue of a beautiful woman.
It was so lifelike that she might have been turned to stone.
She almost seemed to be drinking happily
from the spring beside her...
A statue of a fighter held a sign.
"If you wish to test your luck, proceed."
But this room was a dead end.
Was this some kind of riddle?
There was a brand-new sign.
"Do not disturb the sleep of the dead."
A basket of the sort used for shopping lay on the ground.
Its decaying condition showed
how much time had passed.
Words resembling a spell were written on the floor.
"May those who seek my possessions
wander for eternity."
A paper talisman was attached, bearing a message...
"Let those of gentle heart be welcomed here."
Was it some kind of charm?
"Let those of gentle heart be driven to the brink."
A magic circle and a message were carved into the floor.
"Seal away malice."
You could make out faded lettering on a decaying sign.
"Please enjoy our delicious water."
A drinking fountain was visible farther in.
Was it some facility left from long ago?
The water looked clear.
There was a broken treasure chest.
Will you examine it?
You found nothing particularly suspicious or valuable.
You decided to ignore the treasure chest.
A jar sat there.
Look inside the jar
Ignore the jar
There was some slightly cloudy water inside.
Try drinking it
It tasted extremely bitter,
but you felt it was good for your health.
When you looked into the emptied jar,
water had already begun gathering inside again.
You gently put the jar back.
You ignored the jar.
Then the jar shattered.
A charming little sign hung in front of the door.
"A beloved family, forever."
The handwriting was sweet,
but you sensed something twisted in the feelings behind the sign.
Words were carved on the door.
"A room to give you time to reflect on yourself."
The words seemed to hold some significance.
Red letters were carved into the floor.
"One step forward."
You had an extremely ominous feeling.
The sense of foreboding was so strong
that going any farther felt dangerous.
There was a statue of a large bird.
It seemed to be threatening you.
Or perhaps it was meant as a warning.
One of the statue's eyes was conspicuously missing.
There was a statue of a small bird.
